values.name: Champaner
values.description: Champaner and Pavagadh form a UNESCO World Heritage archaeological landscape containing fortifications, temples, mosques and historic water structures. Champaner preserves remains of the Gujarat Sultanate's former capital.

records.notes: Destination covers the Champaner travel area; hotel and restaurant addresses explicitly identify surrounding villages/Halol.

values.name: Jami Masjid, Champaner
values.entry_fee: INR35 Indian online group-of-monuments ticket; INR40 counter ticket; shared pass conditions apply
values.description: Jami Masjid is a monumental mosque at Champaner, with carved pillars, minarets, a courtyard and stone screens.
values.best_time_note: Visit duration is the midpoint of published 1-2 hours. An older government report documents accessibility funding, not completion; wheelchair status remains unknown. Admission is a shared monument pass, which the current per-attraction budget schema cannot fully model.
values.source: Gujarat Tourism; Google Maps; published visitor guides

records.notes: Coordinates/rating archived pages/champaner-jami.json. Online35/counter40 corroborated in two authored travel accounts and a publicly indexed June2026 ASI e-ticket. Sunrise/sunset hours are not converted into invented fixed clock times.

values.name: Kevada Masjid
values.description: Kevada Masjid is a mosque monument north of Champaner's citadel, accompanied by a separate cenotaph.
values.entry_fee: Shared Champaner monument pass; separate current charge unverified
values.best_time_note: One hour is the lower end of a published 1-2 hour visit recommendation. Shared-pass pricing and conflicting separate-charge reports cannot be represented reliably as an independent fee; numeric admission remains unknown. Wheelchair access unverified.

records.notes: Exact mosque result archived pages/champaner-kevada-selected.json. No duplicate monument-pass charge or invented free ticket.

values.name: Champaner Heritage Resort
values.location: Village Bhamaria, off Champaner-Jambughoda Road, Gujarat 389360
values.description: Champaner Heritage Resort provides heritage-style rooms and suites, a restaurant, pool and garden grounds in Bhamaria near Champaner.
values.source: Official resort; Gujarat Tourism; Google Maps Yatra quote

records.notes: Google Maps Yatra INR9092 for October2-3 2026, two adults, breakfast included, room/taxes unspecified. Dynamic nightly quote archived pages/champaner-hotel.json. Hotel is outside the monument village; real road routes reflect distance.
